signal: Named Pritchard CFO; CEO says he will "modernize finance with AI and automation." Also opened a new New Jersey facility.
why_icp: A new CFO with a stated mandate to automate finance. That is the exact conversation Ramp wants to be in.
first_line: Saw the goal to modernize finance with AI and automation. Happy to show what that looks like for card spend and bill pay.

signal: Hired a new CFO (Mike Etheridge) and CRO at the same time; serves 20,000+ customers.
why_icp: New CFO plus new CRO usually means new plans, new spend and a fresh look at the finance stack.
first_line: Congrats on the new CFO and CRO. A new leadership team is usually when the finance stack gets a fresh look.

signal: Named Clay Schaper CFO to support global expansion after strong 2026 revenue.
why_icp: CFO hired specifically to strengthen financial infrastructure while the company grows globally. Spend controls across countries is a Ramp use case.
first_line: Saw the plan to strengthen financial infrastructure as you grow globally. Spend controls across countries is usually step one.

signal: Named Karen Brown Garza CFO to support national expansion; backed by Kinzie Capital Partners.
why_icp: PE-backed, expanding nationally, and the new CFO is focused on cost management. Project-based spend across many sites fits cards and bill pay.
first_line: Congrats on the CFO role. National expansion with tighter cost management is a lot of spend to keep visible.

signal: Named Matt Ofilos CFO, former CFO of AWS Worldwide Public Sector, during what the CEO calls significant growth.
why_icp: Fast-growing defense tech company with a new CFO from AWS. Big, growing spend base.
suggested_contact_title: Chief Financial Officer or VP Finance
first_line: Congrats on bringing Matt on. Growth across every part of the business usually means spend is growing faster than the controls.

signal: Named Kevin Fox CFO as it ramps production and prepares to go public.
why_icp: Pre-IPO company scaling manufacturing. A CFO getting ready for public-company controls will look hard at spend management and close.
first_line: Congrats on the CFO hire ahead of going public. A faster close tends to be one of the first projects.

signal: Named Steven Vattuone, former ON24 CFO, to support global growth.
why_icp: AI software company scaling go-to-market with a public-company CFO. Software spend and travel grow quickly in that phase.
first_line: Congrats on the new role. Scaling go-to-market usually means a lot more software and travel spend to control.

signal: Named Ryan Hill CFO to support growth in federal health and public safety.
why_icp: Growing government contractor with a new CFO. Contractors need clean spend records, which is a strong fit for Ramp's controls.
first_line: Congrats on the CFO role. Growing a federal contractor means spend records that stand up to audits.

signal: Named Amy Burhorn CFO to oversee accounting, finance and technology during its expansion.
why_icp: Restaurant franchise growing locations, and the CFO also owns technology. One person owning finance and tech tools can mean a shorter sales cycle.
first_line: Congrats on the new role. Owning both finance and tech during an expansion is a good spot to simplify spend.

signal: Named a new CFO (Reed) to support portfolio growth ahead of its 50th anniversary.
why_icp: Hotel operator with spend spread across many properties. Property-level cards and bill pay are a common Ramp story in hospitality.
first_line: Congrats on the new CFO role. Managing spend across many hotels is a lot of invoices.
